LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription: The Games on Demand version supports  English, Czech, Hungarian, Polish, Russian, Korean, Chinese. (Online Interactions Not Rated by the ESRB) Fable III is the next blockbuster installment in the highly praised Fable franchise.
